title: a type-only import of an untrusted foreign module adds no runtime requirement and is accepted
notes: specification/type-system.mdx, 'Foreign Boundaries': 'Type-only imports add neither runtime requirement.' This case is the positive half of a matched pair: it imports the SAME module that 09-foreign-calls/foreign-module-without-a-trust-marker imports as a value and gets SMITHERS1510 for. The difference in verdict between the two cases is the whole obligation, and it is observable without reading a requirement row. WITHDRAWAL (2026-08-23): the case previously also cited specification/compatibility.mdx 'Runtime TypeScript Dependency', a section removed with the `TypeScript` requirement. The surviving obligation is the module-edge trust rule and the type-only exemption from it, both of which this pair still measures.
